cell_wall_degrading_enzymes_check.paper_claim: genes encoding chitinases, β-1,3 glucanases, and proteases were also detected
cell_wall_degrading_enzymes_check.verdict: PARTIAL — protease claim REPLICATED (54 peptidases/proteases annotated). Chitinase and β-1,3-glucanase claims NOT REPRODUCED in the current PGAP annotation. GH family 25 hits are lysozyme-family (peptidoglycan hydrolysis), not chitinase; GH family 3 can hit β-glucans but is broadly specific. Paper may have used a different annotation tool (RAST is mentioned) or a looser homology threshold. This is a real, testable discrepancy — the claim of fungal-cell-wall-degrading enzymes (as a plant-fungal-pathogen biocontrol motivation) is not obviously supported by current PGAP annotation.
